summary: Escape to our 3BR/2BA log cabin in Island Park, just 30 mins from Yellowstone! This cozy retreat sleeps 10 and is nestled in a pine forest with frequent moose sightings. description:
This cozy, wood-paneled log cabin blends authentic rustic charm with modern comforts, comfortably sleeping up to 10 guests. The warm interior features wood-log walls, a stone fireplace, and comfortable seating for your whole group to gather after a day of exploring.

• Bedrooms: Two main-floor bedrooms plus a spacious loft sleeping area provide flexible arrangements for your group.
• Bathrooms: Two full bathrooms. The downstairs bath has a tub and shower combo, while the upstairs bath features a walk-in shower.
• Kitchen: The fully equipped kitchen includes a refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, and a Keurig coffee machine. It's stocked with full cookware for preparing delicious meals.
• Living Area: Relax by the cozy propane fireplace or stream your favorite shows on the smart TV.
• Family-Friendly: A high chair is available for our youngest guests.
• Connectivity & Comfort: Enjoy fast, reliable Wifi throughout the cabin, an in-unit washer and dryer, and ceiling fans for summer airflow.

During your stay, you will have full and private access to the entire property. Make yourself at home and enjoy all the amenities, including:
• The entire 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom cabin and loft.
• A relaxing private hot tub on the deck, perfect for stargazing.
• An outdoor fire pit for evening stories and s'mores.
• A BBQ grill and patio seating for al fresco dining.

We respect our guests' privacy and provide a seamless self-check-in process. While we won't be on-site, we are readily available via the app or phone if you need anything during your stay. Our goal is for you to have a private and relaxing getaway.

• Security: For your safety and security, exterior security cameras are located on the property monitoring the entrances.
• Wildlife: Our cabin is in a natural, wooded area. You are very likely to see local wildlife. Enjoy the view, but please be respectful and keep your distance for both your safety and theirs.
• Cabin Layout: As is common with log cabins, sound can carry easily between rooms. Light sleepers may prefer the bedrooms furthest from the shared living spaces.

The main floor has one sleeping suite with three twin bunk beds, sleeping 6, and its own en suite bathroom, along with a shared kitchen and living room where everyone can cook and hang out together.

In total, Teton Suites sleeps 16 guests across one queen bed and fourteen twin beds, making it a great fit for groups who don't mind bunk-style sleeping and want to be close together rather than tucked away in private rooms.

Guests have full access to the three sleeping suites and the shared kitchen and living room, along with the gravel parking area, which includes a grill, outdoor chairs, and a fire table. The garage, main home, and lawn areas are not included in your stay and are not accessible to guests.

- Access to the upstairs suites requires climbing a staircase; there is no elevator
- The property is located down a long dirt road off the highway
- Showers throughout the property are compact in size
- Sleeping is mostly bunk-style with only one queen bed on the entire property; this layout works best for groups rather than couples looking for a private room
- Full kitchen does not include an oven/stove, but does include a crockpot, air fryer, toaster oven,  toaster, and dishwasher.
